[Regularity boost (Remark 35.32)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0322 1. ch35:35.32\group Dynamic Stability

Initial data in a $1+\beta $ little Hölder neighborhood converge in the $2+\alpha $ topology for suitable $\beta >\alpha $.
